summary: This script starts an n8n service in the background using Docker Compose, then prints a message telling you where to access it. The script uses defensive settings to fail immediately if anything goes wrong.

explanations.2: These flags make the script exit immediately if any command fails, treat undefined variables as errors, and stop if any command in a pipe fails—this prevents silent failures.
explanations.5: dirname "$0" gets the directory where this script itself is located, so Docker Compose can find the compose.yaml file even if you run the script from a different folder.
